parsed.name: 通量可调超导量子比特
parsed.description: 一种工作于低温量子测量系统中的超导量子比特，可通过微波信号进行驱动与读出，并通过磁通偏置调谐到甜点或反甜点附近。该器件常用于连续波谱测、时域相干实验、磁通扫描、自动表征以及量子读出链优化。
parsed.description_en: A superconducting qubit used in low-temperature quantum measurement systems. It is controlled and read out with microwave signals and can be tuned with magnetic flux bias near sweet spots or anti-sweet spots. It is commonly used for continuous-wave spectroscopy, time-domain coherence experiments, flux tuning, automated characterization, and optimization of the qubit readout chain.

actions.description: 准备量子比特用于连续波谱测，并配置适合相位与角度检测的读出通道。
actions.description_en: Prepare the qubit for continuous-wave spectroscopy and configure the readout channels for phase and angle-based detection.

actions.description: 配置量子比特读出，设置读出频率与微波源，并生成读出脉冲。
actions.description_en: Configure qubit readout by setting the readout frequencies and microwave sources and generating the readout pulse.

actions.description: 准备量子比特用于时域实验。
actions.description_en: Prepare the qubit for time-domain experiments.

actions.description: 准备量子比特进行磁通偏置或磁通脉冲实验。
actions.description_en: Prepare the qubit for flux-bias tuning or flux-pulse experiments.

actions.description: 准备量子比特进行自动表征，并将相关其他量子比特停放到合适的偏置点。
actions.description_en: Prepare the qubit for automated characterization and park the other relevant qubits at suitable bias points.

actions.description: 打开用于谱测的采集模式。
actions.description_en: Enable the acquisition mode used for spectroscopy.

actions.description: 关闭用于谱测的采集模式。
actions.description_en: Disable the acquisition mode used for spectroscopy.

actions.description: 以设定功率打开量子比特谱测微波源，可选择脉冲方式。
actions.description_en: Turn on the spectroscopy microwave source for the qubit at the specified power, optionally in pulsed mode.

actions.description: 关闭量子比特谱测微波源。
actions.description_en: Turn off the spectroscopy microwave source for the qubit.

actions.description: 获取量子比特磁通控制通道的参数。
actions.description_en: Get the parameters of the qubit flux-control channel.

actions.description: 配置积分平均读出检测，用于量子比特信号的积分与平均测量。
actions.description_en: Configure integrated-averaging readout detection for integrating and averaging the qubit measurement signal.

actions.description: 初始化参数泵浦控制器，用于TWPA泵浦音调及其抵消音调的产生。
actions.description_en: Initialize the parametric pump controller for generating TWPA pump tones and their cancellation tones.
